subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 7: short -e- words (ten, pen, hen, pet, red)

show.line: Listen for e in the middle. Ten, pen, hen, red!

rounds.prompt: Listen. h, e, n. What word is it?
Which word has e in the middle?
How many candles? Ten! Tap the word ten.
rounds.praise: Yes! Ten candles on the cake.

hints: e in the middle. p, e, n. Pen.
Say each sound, then say them fast.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will read this word.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! It says pen. e in the middle.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's read it together. p, e, n. Pen!

parent_line: Can read short e words like ten, pen, hen and red.
